csv_project_name: Developer for NW 7th Ave Development Tucker Hill Section 4
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Ocala ( City ), through this Invitation to Negotiate ( ITN ) GRM/260685, seeks proposals from interested and qualified developers, builders, partnerships and/or agencies interested in constructing a residential development on the subject parcels to include a mix of single-family detached residential homes and an open space area. The City s intent is to use the property for the creation of Affordable Housing while maintaining quality construction and site design. Land Area: 0.74 Acres (combined).
